rows.canonical: V4.1 EP session construction ownership result
rows.definition: Reports one authenticated EP loader invocation's returned Session/coordinator, error, separately flagged panic payload, ownership transfer, and construction-owned retirement observation.
rows.distinction: A construction outcome, not a runtime Session or scheduler fresh/restored origin. Successful transfer leaves factory retirement unavailable/not applicable and ownership with the caller. Unsuccessful opaque constructors leave hidden cleanup unknown unless an observed outer-release failure proves incomplete retirement. The additive result API returns this evidence; the compatibility wrapper rethrows the original primary panic. Group/backend remain borrowed; no field proves device execution.
